# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

items.t: Open pmmvy.wcd.gov.in, press Login, choose Citizen, verify your mobile with OTP and create your profile. If you cannot do it, ask your Anganwadi worker or ASHA to fill the form for you on her app.
Choose Beneficiary Registration, verify Aadhaar with OTP, fill the eligibility proof, LMP and check-up dates and the Anganwadi centre, then submit and note the registration number.
The Anganwadi worker checks your details and the block officer approves. Rs.3,000 is then sent to your Aadhaar-linked account.
After the birth, register the baby's birth and get the 14-week vaccines. Then log in again, or ask the Anganwadi worker, to fill the child's details. Rs.2,000 is sent next.
If your second child is a girl, apply after her birth and 14-week vaccines. Rs.6,000 is sent in one payment.
Check progress under Track Application Status on the portal. For a delay, use Lodge Grievance on the same site or call 1515.
1515 (POSHAN and PMMVY toll-free helpline; earlier 14408)
Andaman & Nicobar Old Age Pension (Social Security Pension)
Directorate of Social Welfare, Andaman & Nicobar Administration

Old people in the islands get Rs.2,500 a month from 60, and Rs.3,000 a month from 80, paid into their bank account. It is for people who have lived in the islands for at least 10 years and whose household earns less than Rs.48,000 a year. One common form covers the old age, widow, destitute and disability pensions. You hand it in at the CDPO office of your area. More than 15,600 people get this pension.
Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.3,000 a month from age 80)
Age 60 years or above
Living in the islands continuously for at least 10 years (local certificate or resident identity card)
Household income less than Rs.48,000 a year (Rs.4,000 a month)
Not getting any other pension, allowance or grant from the government
From age 80 the pension rises to Rs.3,000 a month
Local certificate or domicile certificate
Bank account number (passbook copy)
Income and residence certificate from the Tehsildar (printed on the form)
Age certificate from a Medical Officer (printed on the form)
Certificate from your Pradhan or Councillor (printed on the form)
Signed declaration that you get no other government assistance
Directorate of Social Welfare, A&N Administration

The office of the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of your area: Urban (Sri Vijaya Puram), Ferrargunj, Rangat, Diglipur or Car Nicobar. Forms are also free at the Directorate of Social Welfare, Goalghar, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair). Before you submit, get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate filled in on the form. Attach the local certificate and an Aadhaar copy.
Name of assistance applied for
Tick Old Age Pension. The same form is used for widow, destitute and disability pensions.
Name of the applicant
K. Muniyamma
Father's / Husband's name
Late K. Arumugam
Write 'Late' if he has died.
Male or Female.
Married / Unmarried / Widow
Your present status.
Must show you are 60 or more. The Medical Officer certifies your age on the form.
Present address
House 42, Garacharma-II, South Andaman
Where you live now, with village or ward.
Category (APL / BPL)
As on your ration card.
Details of assistance received from Govt./local bodies
Nil
Write Nil if you get no pension or grant. Anyone already getting one is not eligible.
Bank account number and Aadhaar number
The pension is paid into this account every month.
Download the pension form or collect it free at the CDPO office or the Directorate of Social Welfare.
Get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate on the form.
Sign the declaration and hand in the form with your local certificate and Aadhaar copy at your CDPO office.
The CDPO checks that you get no other assistance and sends the case to the Directorate of Social Welfare for sanction.
Once sanctioned, Rs.2,500 (Rs.3,000 from age 80) is paid into your bank account every month.
Give a life certificate every year in the prescribed format to your Anganwadi worker or Mukhya Sevika, or the pension is suspended.
03192-233356 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair); your CDPO office
Annadata Sukhibhava – PM Kisan (Rs.20,000 farmer support)
Agriculture Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh, with PM-KISAN, Government of India

Andhra Pradesh pays farmer families Rs.20,000 a year for crop costs. Rs.14,000 of it comes from the state and Rs.6,000 from PM-Kisan, all sent by DBT in three instalments. It replaced the earlier YSR Rythu Bharosa. Farmers whose land is in the state land records are listed automatically. Anyone missing from the list, and tenant farmers, register or complain at their Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK).
Rs.20,000 a year in three instalments: Rs.7,000, Rs.7,000 and Rs.6,000
Farmer family (husband, wife and minor children) with cultivable land recorded in their name in the Andhra Pradesh land records (Webland / 1-B). One payment per family
Tenant farmers with a valid Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) for the season, and tribal farmers holding forest-rights (ROFR) land, are also covered
Not for families with an income-tax payer, a serving or retired government employee (Group D staff excepted), or a pensioner drawing Rs.10,000 a month or more
Not for practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants or architects, holders of constitutional posts, or institutions that own land
Aadhaar e-KYC must be complete, and the bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped
Aadhaar card of the farmer
Pattadar passbook, or the 1-B / Adangal extract of the land
Bank passbook showing account number and IFSC (Aadhaar-seeded account)
CCRC card, for a tenant farmer
ROFR title, for forest-rights land
Annadatha Sukhibhava – PM Kisan portal

The Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) in your village. Take Aadhaar, the pattadar passbook or 1-B, the bank passbook and, for tenants, the CCRC card. The Village Agriculture Assistant registers you, does your e-KYC and files a grievance if your name is missing from the eligible list.
Narasimha Rao Kotha
It must match the name in the land record and the bank account, or the money gets stuck.
The farmer's own 12 digits. Status is checked and payment is made on this number.
The number linked to Aadhaar. OTPs and payment messages come here.
Land owner
Land owner, tenant (CCRC holder) or forest-rights (ROFR) holder.
Prakasam / Darsi / Thurpu Veerayapalem
The village where the land is, not where you live.
Khata number and survey number
Khata 1187, Survey 214/2B
Copy them from the pattadar passbook or 1-B. The assistant checks them against Webland.
Extent of land
2.40 acres
Your share as shown in the land record. If land is held jointly, only one family member is paid.
CCRC number (tenants only)
Not applicable
Tenant farmers write the number of this season's Crop Cultivator Rights Card. An expired card is rejected.
Make sure the account is Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped. Ask your bank if you are not sure.
Done by fingerprint at RSK
Without e-KYC no instalment is released. It can be done at the RSK with your thumb.
Open annadathasukhibhava.ap.gov.in, tap Know Your Status and enter your Aadhaar. Or check the eligible list on the notice board at your Rythu Seva Kendram.
If your name is missing or shown ineligible, go to the RSK with Aadhaar, pattadar passbook or 1-B, bank passbook and, for tenants, the CCRC card.
The Village Agriculture Assistant registers you or enters a grievance in the grievance module and does your e-KYC by fingerprint. Note the grievance number.
The Agriculture Officer verifies the land record and exclusions. Updated lists are put up at the RSK again.
Make sure your bank account is linked to Aadhaar and NPCI-mapped, or the payment fails even after approval.
The money comes by DBT in three parts each year: Rs.7,000 (Rs.5,000 state + Rs.2,000 PM-Kisan), Rs.7,000, and Rs.6,000 (Rs.4,000 state + Rs.2,000 PM-Kisan). Check your bank passbook.
If an instalment does not arrive, check the status again on the portal and call the toll-free number 155251.
155251 — AP Agriculture Department toll-free (Annadata Sukhibhava) / 155261 — PM-KISAN helpline
Thalliki Vandanam (Rs.15,000 per school child to mothers)
School Education Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

Andhra Pradesh gives Rs.15,000 a year for every child studying in Class 1 to 12 to the child's mother or guardian, however many children she has. Rs.13,000 is credited to her bank account and Rs.2,000 is kept for school upkeep. It replaced the earlier Jagananna Amma Vodi. There is no application form: the school sends the child's details and the Secretariat checks the family. Mothers left out complain at the Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office.
Rs.15,000 a year per child: Rs.13,000 to the mother's account, Rs.2,000 for school upkeep
Mother or guardian of a child in Class 1 to 12, including Intermediate, at a recognised government, aided, private or residential school or junior college in Andhra Pradesh
At least one family member holds a rice card. Family income is up to Rs.10,000 a month in a village or Rs.12,000 a month in a town
Land below 3 acres of wet land, 10 acres of dry land, or 10 acres in all. Average electricity use below 300 units a month
No four-wheeler in the family (a taxi, tractor or auto is allowed), and no town property of 1,000 sq ft or more
No government employee, government pensioner or income-tax payer in the family. Sanitation and Anganwadi workers are exempt
ITI, polytechnic and IIIT (RGUKT) students are not covered
Aadhaar card of the mother or guardian
Aadhaar card of each child
Bank or post office passbook in the mother's name, Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped
The child's school admission details (school name and class), given to the head of the school
Electricity bill or other proof, only if you are disputing the reason you were found ineligible

No application is needed. The head of the school enters the child's details, and the Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office (Village or Ward Secretariat) checks the family. The eligible and ineligible lists are put up at that office. If you are left out, file a grievance there with the Welfare and Education Assistant or the Digital Assistant. Take the mother's and child's Aadhaar, the rice card, the bank passbook and proof against the reason for rejection.
Mother / guardian name
Rama Devi Gollapalli
As on her Aadhaar. The money goes to the mother; to the father only if she is not there, and to a guardian if neither parent is.
Mother's Aadhaar number
She must be in the Secretariat's household database. If only the child is listed, ask for field verification.
Student name
Pavan Gollapalli
Exactly as in the school register. One entry for each child.
Student Aadhaar number
It must match the school's UDISE record, or the child is dropped as a duplicate.
School name and class
ZP High School, Kovvur — Class 8
Any recognised government, aided, private or residential school, or a junior college for Intermediate.
Rice card number
At least one person in the family must hold a rice card.
In the mother's own name. It must be Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped, or the payment fails.
Reason shown as ineligible
Electricity use above 300 units
Read the reason on the list at the office. Common ones are electricity, land, four-wheeler, government job and income tax.
Your objection
The meter is shared by three rented portions; our own use is about 120 units
Say plainly why the reason is wrong and attach proof, such as the bill, a rent agreement or a land record.
Make sure the school has your child's correct Aadhaar, and your own name and Aadhaar as the mother. The head of the school enters these details.
Keep your bank account Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped. Ask the bank or post office to check it.
When the money is released (late July in 2026), check your passbook and look for your name on the eligible list at the Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office.

If you are left out or shown ineligible, file a grievance at that office within the window it announces (22 July to 3 August in 2026). Take Aadhaar, the rice card, the passbook and proof against the reason. Keep the grievance number.
Staff verify the grievance at your home or with records and prepare a supplementary list.
If accepted, Rs.13,000 for each eligible child is credited to your account in the second round (30 August in 2026).
For help, ask the Welfare and Education Assistant at the office or call 1902.
1902 — AP government citizen helpline (Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward and Secretariat services)
AP Building and Other Construction Workers Registration (Construction Worker Card)
AP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

Masons, helpers, carpenters, painters, plumbers, electricians and other construction workers register with the state construction workers' welfare board and get an ID card. Card holders and their families can claim money for marriage, childbirth, natural death and funeral. These benefits were restored from 1 March 2026. Registration costs Rs.50 once plus Rs.12 a year, and claims are made through the Village or Ward Secretariat.
Rs.20,000 marriage gift, Rs.20,000 maternity help, Rs.60,000 on natural death, Rs.20,000 funeral expenses
Age 18 to 59 at the time of registration
Worked at least 90 days in the past 12 months in building or other construction work in Andhra Pradesh: mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, centring, tiles and similar trades
Road workers employed for more than 90 days and mining workers can also register
Registration fee of Rs.50 once, plus a contribution of Rs.12 a year; the card must be renewed to stay valid
Benefits are paid only to workers holding a valid, renewed card. Marriage help covers a woman worker and two daughters, and maternity help covers a woman worker, the wife and two daughters
Certificate of 90 days of construction work, signed by the employer or builder, a registered trade union, or the labour officer
Passport-size photograph and signature
Bank passbook showing account number and IFSC
Rice card and age proof
Names, ages and relation of family members, and the nominee
Registration fee of Rs.50 plus Rs.12 for each year
AP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

Register at the Assistant Labour Officer's office for your mandal or town, or ask the Digital Assistant at your Village or Ward Secretariat (Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office) to guide you. Take the filled Form XXVII, Aadhaar, the 90-day work certificate, a photo, the bank passbook and the fee. To claim a benefit later, apply at the Secretariat through the Digital Assistant or the Ward Education and Development Secretary on the AP Seva portal, with your worker card and proof of the event.
Your own 12 digits. One registration per person.
Appala Raju Kandregula, 12-03-1988
As on Aadhaar. You must be 18 or older and below 60.
Father / Husband name
Kandregula Satyam

Tick SC, ST, BC, Minority or Others. Messages about the card and claims come to the phone.
Family members and nominee
Lakshmi (wife, 33) — nominee 100%; Sravani (daughter, 12); Ganesh (son, 9)
Name, age and relation of each. The nominee gets the money if you die. Shares must add up to 100%.
Bank details
9999 0033 6620 / IOBA0001234, Indian Overseas Bank, Anakapalli
An account in your own name. All benefits are paid into it by DBT.
Door 4-12, Gandhi Nagar, Anakapalli, Anakapalli district 531001
Door number, street, village or town, mandal, district and PIN code.
Are you a VB-G RAM G (rural job card) worker?
VB-G RAM G is the rural job scheme that replaced MGNREGA. If you hold a job card, give its number.
Name of employer and construction site
Sri Venkateswara Builders — apartment site, Sabbavaram Road
Where you work now. This employer, a registered union or the labour officer signs your 90-day certificate.
Name of trade
Mason
Mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, centring, tiles, welder and so on.

Get Form XXVII (the board's PDF, or a copy from the labour office) and fill it in. Have your employer, a registered trade union or the labour officer sign the certificate of 90 days of work on the back.
Take the form, Aadhaar, a photo, the bank passbook and the fee (Rs.50 plus Rs.12 a year) to the Assistant Labour Officer's office. The Secretariat's Digital Assistant can tell you where yours is.
The labour officer checks your work and enters your details online. Keep the receipt with your registration number.
Collect your construction worker ID card, and renew it before it expires. A lapsed card cannot claim any benefit.

When there is a marriage, a birth, or a death in the family, apply soon afterwards at your Village or Ward Secretariat. The Digital Assistant or the Ward Education and Development Secretary files it on AP Seva with your card and the marriage, birth or death certificate.
The labour officer verifies the claim and the board sends the money to the bank account by Aadhaar-linked DBT.
To check whether your registration is active, ask at the labour office or the Secretariat, or call 1902.
0866-2436311 — Commissioner of Labour, Vijayawada / 1902 — AP government citizen helpline
Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (Aarogyasri Health Card)
Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

Free, cashless hospital treatment of up to Rs.25 lakh a year for a family, for 3,257 listed surgeries and treatments, at government and private network hospitals in Andhra Pradesh. It is the state's Aarogyasri scheme, called Dr YSR Aarogyasri until 2024. Every rice card family is covered already. Other families with an income of up to Rs.5 lakh apply for the card at their Village or Ward Secretariat.
Cashless treatment up to Rs.25 lakh a year per family, with free medicines, food and bus fare home
Every family holding an Andhra Pradesh rice card is covered, with no further check
Other families qualify if their annual income is up to Rs.5 lakh. This includes contract, outsourced, part-time and private-sector workers and income-tax filers within that limit
Land below 12 acres of wet land or 35 acres of dry land, and below 35 acres in all
In towns, municipal property tax paid on less than 3,000 sq ft. The family may own no more than one car
Permanent government employees and pensioners are not covered here; they have the separate EHS card
Rice card of the family, if you have one
Income certificate, salary certificate or income-tax return showing income up to Rs.5 lakh (only for families without a rice card)
Pattadar passbook, if the family owns land
Municipal property tax receipt, if you live in a town
Mobile number and a recent family photograph
Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust

Your Village or Ward Secretariat (now called the Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office). Ask the Digital Assistant for the NTR Vaidya Seva health card. Take Aadhaar for every member, the rice card or an income certificate, and the pattadar passbook or property tax receipt. Your household must already appear in the Secretariat's household survey. For treatment, go to the Aarogya Mithra desk at any network hospital or PHC.

The head of the family's 12-digit number. The Digital Assistant checks it with your thumbprint.
Household ID (household survey)
The Secretariat finds it from your Aadhaar. If your family is missing from the survey, ask for it to be added first.
If your family has a rice card, you are covered already and do not need to apply. Just show it at the hospital.
Srinivas Palli (husband, 44), Divya (daughter, 15), Kiran (son, 11)
Everyone who lives and eats with you. Each person needs their own Aadhaar.
Annual family income and proof
Rs.3,60,000; salary certificate from Sri Sai Textiles, Guntur
It must be Rs.5 lakh or less. Attach the salary certificate, income certificate or income-tax return.
Land held
Wet 0, Dry 1.5 acres
Copy it from the pattadar passbook. Wet land must be under 12 acres and dry land under 35 acres.
House area for municipal tax
850 sq ft
Only for towns. It is on your property tax receipt and must be under 3,000 sq ft.
Number of four-wheelers owned
One car is allowed. A family with two or more cars cannot get the card.
Messages about the application and the card come to this number.
If your family has a rice card, you are covered already. Skip to the hospital step.

Otherwise, go to your Village or Ward Secretariat with Aadhaar for every member, an income certificate and your land or property tax papers. The Digital Assistant applies for the Vaidya Seva card. Keep the acknowledgement number.
Secretariat staff check income, land, property and vehicles. Once approved, the card is issued to the family through the Secretariat.

When you need treatment, go to a PHC, a government hospital or any network hospital listed on drntrvaidyaseva.ap.gov.in. Meet the Aarogya Mithra at the help desk and show the card, rice card or Aadhaar. Your fingerprint is taken.
The hospital asks the Trust for approval before the operation. Tests, surgery, medicines and two meals a day are all free, so do not pay anything.
At discharge you get 10 days of medicines and bus fare home, and you sign a letter saying you paid nothing. For listed surgeries, the Aarogya Aasara recovery allowance goes to your bank account.
If a hospital asks for money, refuses treatment or you need help, call 104.
104 — Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva and Aarogya Aasara information and complaints / 108 — emergency ambulance
Deepam-2 (3 free LPG gas cylinders a year)
Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

Andhra Pradesh gives every eligible rice card family three 14.2 kg LPG cylinders a year free, one in each four-month block. You book the cylinder with your gas agency in the usual way and pay for it, and the full amount is refunded to your Aadhaar-linked bank account, usually within 48 hours. There is no form: families with a rice card and a gas connection are listed automatically. You can check your status with your rice card or LPG number.
3 free 14.2 kg LPG cylinders a year, one every four months, with the full price refunded
The family holds an Andhra Pradesh rice card
It has an active domestic LPG connection from Indane, HP or Bharat Gas in a family member's name, linked to the rice card. Ujjwala connections count
One connection per rice card household; a family with two connections gets the benefit on only one
The household must pass the rice card checks on electricity use, government employment and land, which are the reasons the status page gives for rejection
LPG e-KYC done at the gas agency, and a bank account seeded with the connection holder's Aadhaar
LPG gas book or consumer number
Aadhaar card of the connection holder
Bank account seeded with that Aadhaar
Mobile number registered with the gas agency
Beneficiary Management portal (Deepam 2.0 Status Check)

No form is needed. Book the cylinder with your own gas agency by phone, SMS, WhatsApp or app, and pay on delivery. If you are not on the eligible list, go to your Village or Ward Secretariat (Swarna Gramam / Swarna Ward office) or the mandal Civil Supplies office with the rice card, gas book and Aadhaar. Complete LPG e-KYC at your gas agency.
Rice card number or LPG consumer number
Type either one on the Deepam 2.0 Status Check page. The rice card number is on the front of the card.
Type the letters shown in the picture. Tap refresh if you cannot read them.
LPG connection holder
Bhavani Yerramsetti
The family member in whose name the gas connection stands. The refund goes to her Aadhaar-seeded account.
District / Mandal
